transport_failure_taxonomy.candidate_startup_timeout: Candidate import/readiness exceeded its bounded startup window.

transport_failure_taxonomy.frame_parse_failure: A complete frame was not valid JSON or did not match the expected shape.

transport_failure_taxonomy.resource_timeout: Candidate execution exceeded its per-call or task time budget.
